title: Resource-aware safety gate and dashboard for microbatch recommender
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Background: We have multiple experiments that apply dynamic microbatch and KV-prefetch recommendations. Past runs reduced cost but occasionally increased tail latency for a small slice of traffic. Objective: Build a resource-aware safety gate and a purpose-built A/B dashboard that measures economic benefit vs latency/regression risk and automates fast, reversible config applies with clear rollback triggers. Scope: experiment harness, metrics, dashboard panels, automated guardrail service, runbook and one canary rollout to 5% traffic cohorts.
acceptance_criteria: Safety gate service can independently accept a recommended config and simulate impact using replay for a given 1h traffic snapshot
Dashboard surfaces units: cost per 1k tokens, p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, payload size distribution by cohort, and percent of traffic routed to fallbacks
Automated rollback triggers defined and executed within 3 minutes of threshold breach for canary cohorts
End-to-end test that injects a config causing a latency spike will result in automated rollback and an incident annotation in the dashboard
Canary rollout pipeline documented and runbook created with clear owner assignments
experiment_design: Randomize at API-key level into control (current configs) and treatment (recommended microbatch+cache profile)
Start with 1% treatment, ramp to 5% after 48h if no guardrail breaches, then to 20% with manual approval
Holdouts: include a regulated customer cohort excluded from experiments by default
Traffic stratification: stable web clients, mobile short-seq clients, long-context clients; ensure balanced assignment across strata
Duration: minimum 72h at each ramp step to collect tail latency and economic signals
metrics: Primary econ metric: tokens_served_cost_per_1k (hosted GPU unit cost normalized)
Primary safety metrics: p95_latency_ms, p99_latency_ms, error_rate_5xx_percent
Secondary metrics: model_throughput_rps, avg_seq_len, kv_cache_hit_rate, microbatch_size_distribution
User-facing metric: proportion_of_responses_with_quality_regressions (tracked via eval set / golden prompts)
Statistical checks: uplift, bayesian credible intervals, sequential testing with alpha spending to avoid false positives
dashboards: Overview panel: cost vs latency tradeoff scatter with selectable cohorts and time window
Cohort detail: per-API-key p50/p95/p99 latency, cost per 1k tokens, cache hit rate
Drilldown: request traces for latency outliers with request metadata and model variant
Experiment health: cohorts, traffic percent, canary state, recent guardrail events and automated rollbacks
Statistical summary: lift estimates with CI and Bayes factors; flag if underpowered
rollout_plan: Stage 0 - Dry run: validate metrics pipeline on historical replay for 24h (no production traffic)
Stage 1 - Canary 1%: enable treatment for 1% of traffic; monitor for 24-48h
Stage 2 - Canary 5%: if Stage 1 OK, ramp to 5% and engage on-call SRE for 48h
Stage 3 - Controlled rollout 20%: manual approval by eng+pm after 72h at 5%
Full rollout: incremental ramps and gating based on econ & safety thresholds and PM sign-off
rollback_triggers: Absolute: p99_latency increases by >30% relative to control for two consecutive 10-minute windows
Absolute: error_rate_5xx exceeds 0.5% in treatment for 10 minutes
Relative: cost savings < 1% while safety metrics regress beyond thresholds
Manual: SEV opened by customer or SRE with confirmed impact on production SLAs
automations: Guardrail service listens to real-time telemetry and will call rollout API to revert configs when triggers fire
Automated annotation created on rollback with reason, snapshot of metrics, and a suggested follow-up ticket template
Daily synthesis job that computes cohort-level uplift and flags underpowered experiments for extension or termination
runbook_steps: If guardrail fires: verify signal source and take immediate rollback via ops-runbook endpoint
Post-rollback: capture full 15-minute trace bundle and attach to incident ticket
Root cause: run replay on 24h window with differential tracing enabled
Decision: either adjust recommender heuristics or disable microbatching for affected cohort and schedule remedial AB test
